name: netcs
description: A Personal Website and Blog Starter based on Next 15, React 19, TailwindCSS with DaisyUI, Contentful, and Turso DB.

paragraphs: After so much time working with Contentful and Next, I never found a single consistent way of starting a project, and all starters that tried have their own caveats, some are too basic without touching the real problems like handling GraphQL query complexity limits or are too strict. I'm not saying this starter is better as there are many ways to accomplish the same thing when building with these technologies. Anyway, it was a lot of fun building it, exploring the nice features of React SSR inside Next.js, and playing with Contentful content modeling capabilities.

🚨 WARNING 🚨 This project is the culmination of my own experimentations with Next.js and Contentful and it may not be suitable for your needs. All contents present in Contentful are fake, mostly generated using AI tools like ChatGPT and DALL-E.
